text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa races toward the NHK Mile Cup. However, she also has a problem on her hands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has no rivals running in the same races as her and longs for someone to hone her abilities with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She invites King Halo to join her in the NHK Mile Cup out of desperation, but her reckless request is turned down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Witnessing the exchange, I rack my brain for a way to make her wish for a rival come true.
